items.title: Mahalia Jackson Interview, 1962-05-02
items.q: I have asked some of my friends, like Miss Diana Schoel

ctx.x: Will there be music taught there then? Yes. Well, Mahalia, do you have enough money of your own to complete this project?

No, I'm trying very hard to raise the money from my concerts. And I have asked some of my friends, like Miss Diana Schoel, and the great Mr. Ben Crosby, the great Mr. Frank Sinatra. Well, I think they're all going to help me because they all love me. Are they going to do a show for you or something? Is that true? And use the proceeds for the school? Well, that'll be some help. It's going to take a lot of money, isn't it? Well, the type of school must remain owned because we're going to have people from their…
